description: This file contains unit tests for the ConceptNameSaveHandler class, validating its handling of ConceptName tags under various conditions.

classes.name: ConceptNameSaveHandlerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for ConceptNameSaveHandler, extending BaseContextSensitiveTest to facilitate integration testing within OpenMRS context.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotFailIfTagsIsNull
methods.description: Tests that the handle method does not throw an exception when the ConceptName's tags are null.

methods.name: handle_shouldReplaceTagsWithoutIdsWithDatabaseFetchedTag
methods.description: Ensures that tags without IDs are replaced with database-fetched tags with appropriate IDs.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotReplaceTagsWithoutIdsThatAreNotInTheDatabase
methods.description: Verifies that tags with no IDs and not present in the database remain without IDs after handling.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotReplaceTagsThatHaveIds
methods.description: Checks that tags with existing IDs are preserved correctly after handling.
